surface-pro.platform_notes: Surface Pro 7+, Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, 4 cores / 7.6 GiB. Daily driver. No ffmpeg and no local LaTeX — tasks needing them must run elsewhere or call the Railway TeX build service. No Microsoft Edge, so CDP-dependent tasks (Blooket upload, Schoology posting, AI Studio ingest) cannot run here; use Chrome or defer to a Windows machine.
